newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY NAMES ADVISORS FOR T.ITALIA SALE.
newsitem.headline: ITALY NAMES ADVISORS FOR T.ITALIA SALE.

text.p: The Italian Treasury on Wednesday named the advisors, regional lead managers and bookrunners for the forthcoming privatisation of state controlled telecoms group, Telecom Italia SpA.
They are:
Joint Global Cordinators: Mediobanca, BZW.
For the public offering of shares aimed at retail investors in Italy:
Regional Lead Manager (RLM) and bookrunner: Mediobanca.
Joint leads: Banca Commerciale Italiana, Credito Italiano, BNL, Banca di Roma, Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino.
Co-leads: Cariplo, MPS, Banca Fideuram
Co-managers: A further 50, made up of Italian banks and brokers
For the institutional placement:
IN ITALY
RLM and bookrunner: Mediobanca.
Senior Co-leads: Banca Commerciale Italiana, Credito Italiano, BNL, Banca di Roma, Istituto Bancario San Paolo, IMI
Co-leads: Cariplo, MPS, BZW, Euromobiliare, Morgan Stanley.
Co-managers: Albertini and Co. SIM, CIMO SIM, Giubergia Warburg SIM, Rasfin SIM.
IN BRITAIN
RLM and bookrunner: BZW.
Co-leads: Cazenove, JP Morgan, Mediobanca, Morgan Stanley, SBC Warburg.
Co-managers: Euromobiliare, Flemings, Lazards, NatWest, Schroders.
IN THE UNITED STATES
RLM and bookrunner: Morgan Stanley.
Joint lead managers: BZW, Lehman.
Co-managers: Bear Stearns, JP Morgan, SBC Warburg, Smith Barney, Salomon, Toronto Dominion, IMI.
IN THE REST OF THE WORLD
RLM and bookrunner: Goldman Sachs.
Joint lead: UBS.
Co-leads: ABN Amro, BZW, Daiwa, Dresdner KB, Euromobiliare, JP Morgan, Mediobanca, Morgan Stanley, SBC Warburg, Santander.
Co-managers: BBL, BCI, Credit Agricole Indosuez, Creditanstalt, DenDanske, DG Bank, Enskilda, HSBC, Rashid Hussain, Societe Generale, West LB.
